authority: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10); USCIS Policy Manual; SEVP guidance

volatility.note: DHS published a final rule on 17 July 2026 (90 FR / RIN 1653-AA95, doc 2026-14439; 8 CFR pts 214, 248, 274a) replacing duration of status for F, J and I nonimmigrants with a fixed period of admission, effective 15 September 2026. As of this pack's verification date the rule is PUBLISHED BUT NOT YET EFFECTIVE. PathWise models the CPT/OPT rules at 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)-(12), which the rule does not appear to amend, so the findings this pack produces are unaffected. PathWise does NOT model the fixed admission period, the extension-of-stay procedure, or the transition provisions for students already admitted under duration of status. A student relying on this product after 15 September 2026 needs advice this product does not give.

cpt.full_time_definition: More than 20 hours/week is full-time CPT; 20 or fewer is part-time.
cpt.cliff_effect: 365 or more days of full-time CPT removes OPT eligibility entirely.
cpt.amber_margin_note: Display band, not a regulation: within 60 days of the cliff the ledger reads amber. Authored here so a jurisdiction can set its own warning distance without touching code.

overlap_aggregation.rule: Concurrent part-time CPT authorizations aggregate; a day whose summed authorized hours exceed 20 counts as a full-time CPT day.
overlap_aggregation.cite: PathWise interpretation — not a located federal authority
overlap_aggregation.basis_note: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(i) defines part-time CPT as 20 hours or less per week and bars post-completion OPT after one year or more of FULL-TIME CPT. It is silent on whether two concurrent part-time authorizations combine into a full-time day. PathWise reads 12 + 12 hours on one day as more than 20 authorized hours on that day, and therefore full-time. That reading is an inference from the hours definition, not a rule any authority states. The prevailing published reading, stated on many university international-office pages, is the opposite: that part-time CPT does not affect OPT eligibility at all. Searched 2026-08-18 for a locating authority (USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 2 Pt. F Ch. 5, SEVP guidance, 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)); none found. Recorded as an interpretation rather than removed, because the arithmetic it drives is shown separately and the reader is told which days depend on it.
overlap_aggregation.contrary_reading: Part-time CPT does not count toward the one-year full-time CPT bar.

level_partition.rule: The CPT/OPT cap is per education level. Bachelor's CPT does not carry into a master's.

cpt.counting_note: Usage runs on authorized periods, not hours actually worked. Overtime and unemployment are not recomputed.

opt.counting_note: Budget usage runs on the AUTHORIZED period, never on hours actually worked. Overtime does not spend more budget; unemployment does not spend less.

level_partition.rule: The 12-month OPT budget is per education level. Master's OPT starts a fresh 12 months.
